business_problem: Okuma needed to replace a 20-year-old legacy environment that kept sales, operations, engineering, warehouse, and service data in silos and made configuration, quoting, order processing, and service workflows too manual.
solution_summary: Okuma America chose Dynamics 365 to unify a highly complex machine-configuration business where each order can span deep bills of materials, many subassemblies, and detailed routing requirements. The implementation was designed to connect distributor quoting, production planning, warehouse visibility, invoicing, and field service so the company could manage a very specialized product catalog without relying on brittle manual processes or disconnected systems. Key components include Experlogix Configure Price Quote, Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, Dynamics 365 Finance, Power Pages, Power Automate, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Okuma has automated quote-to-order-to-invoice workflows, improved warehouse and inventory visibility, and strengthened service execution while giving teams a more complete view of customers and machine configurations.

solution_components.name: Experlogix Configure Price Quote
solution_components.role: handles the specialized distributor quotation and configuration process for complex machine orders

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: stores customer activity and order context for distributors and internal teams

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
solution_components.role: generates BOMs, production routes, inventory planning, and spare-parts workflows from incoming orders

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Finance
solution_components.role: receives order data through dual-write integration for financial processing

solution_components.name: Power Pages
solution_components.role: gives distributors a mirror view of customer activity and a path to interact directly with the call center

solution_components.name: Power Automate
solution_components.role: automatically generates sales orders and invoices once work orders are created

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: uses service cases to drive internal field service activity for installation and support

data_flow: Distributor quotes start in Experlogix and flow into Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, where BOMs and routes are generated automatically and then synchronized into Dynamics 365 Finance. Power Pages shares customer context with distributors, Power Automate converts work into sales orders and invoices, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service turns cases into field-service actions when Okuma's own experts need to intervene.
business_outcome: Okuma has automated quote-to-order-to-invoice workflows, improved warehouse and inventory visibility, and strengthened service execution while giving teams a more complete view of customers and machine configurations.
